_comment: This vault's own lint settings. init-vault.py puts this file at .scripts/lint.config.org.json; the vault owns it, the engine never overwrites it. lint.mjs reads the engine's .scripts/lint.config.json (defaults, and what each key means), then merges this file over it: objects merge key by key; an array or value here REPLACES the engine's. To add to an engine list (operationalFiles, operationalGlobs, deadPointerExcludeSources), copy the whole engine list here and extend it. Typical vault entries: extra operationalFiles, refreshContracts for your own sources, deadPointerExcludeSources for project folders that quote another repo's layout, skills that are yours only (skillsExemptFromRegistration), diff-propose pilot STATEs (stateBudgets.strictFiles), the skills you deploy (deployedSkillMirrors) and scheduled jobs (runIntegrity).
